plainSummary: The plan keeps CLI and MCP behavior aligned while custom methods and activity remain unable to invent permission, evidence, completion, or recovery.
summary: Independent review approves 815c7a44-59df-8102-9769-bf8a74e49c0c after amendments. The current related pack covers five live features (cli, client, turns, verify, lattice), fifteen live claims including 67609c19-de05-862c-8db7-e5dc95f38cee/003/011/015/017/018/019/020/021/022, three proposed claims aae49e39-2b5e-8e27-9378-2a136cce5c93..022, seven prior workstreams, twenty turns, and twenty-eight docs. 26c9bf2f-a090-8415-bd2b-f46dff6af4f7 now requires actual CLI and MCP executables across the lifecycle with matched denial, stale-input, missing-evidence, retry-conflict, idempotency, and no-unintended-side-effect behavior. Started-before-effect and completed-after-effect operation receipts, immutable request digests, unfinished-as-unknown retries, and cross-process serialization bound uncertain execution without unsafe lock stealing. 25eac677-2871-816d-956d-770bdcb61798 defines a finite typed output registry whose satisfaction is derived from current revision/source-bound records and keeps attestation distinct. 87ce7ed9-a607-8425-a475-173f8953ffaf keeps activity observational and recovery unavailable without verified host capability. The security model identifies the fixed-checkout, permission/evidence, skill-path, activity-spoofing, and process-control boundaries and requires real-boundary negative evidence. Criteria map to proposed standing claims 2f8cf085-d7a5-83b9-89f8-9d0754cb16a0..025; live promotion remains builder work.
residualRisks: This is a specification review; implementation parity, browser behavior, protocol behavior, and security denials still require run-backed evidence and independent code-break review in each vertical.
The related command returned only a caution string for sibling worktrees and no structured scan or skippedReason, so this review makes no claim about unpublished parallel checkout state.

No supported host recovery or cancellation adapter is promised by this revision; 87ce7ed9-a607-8425-a475-173f8953ffaf must display those capabilities as unavailable unless a concrete owned adapter is implemented and verified.
